_about: Every solver and every arm the experiments run. `solvers` records each binary: version, commit, where it came from and how setup_solvers.sh obtains it (built entries were built with GCC 14.3.1 and CMake 3.31.8 on Linux). `arms` is what measure.py runs: `cmd` is the command line from this directory, with `{instance}` the instance path, `{stats}` Xorcle's statistics file and `{seed}` the solver seed; a verdict is the first of the `verdict` patterns (UNSAT tried first, multiline) found in stdout, and neither found is UNKNOWN. An arm named `xorcle-0.2_<option>` is Xorcle v0.2 with that one option, and `xorcle-0.2_plain` is Xorcle v0.2 with phase saving, BVE, vivification and the implication graph off. Which file each arm reads is set by each experiment's run.py.

kissat-4.0.4.name: Kissat
kissat-4.0.4.obtained: prebuilt: upstream release asset, statically linked; latest release (2025-10-16)
kissat-4.0.4.model: `v` lines of signed literals ending in 0
kissat-4.0.4.notes: Defaults. Kissat 4.0.4 is also the version Xorcle v0.1 compared against.

cadical-3.0.1.name: CaDiCaL
cadical-3.0.1.obtained: built: the release has no binary asset; `./configure && make` (upstream defaults), g++ 14.3.1 -Wall -Wextra -O3 -DNDEBUG, dynamically linked against libstdc++
cadical-3.0.1.model: `v` lines of signed literals ending in 0

cms-5.17.0.name: CryptoMiniSat
cms-5.17.0.obtained: prebuilt: upstream release asset, statically linked; `--version` reports CMS SHA1 03954f7 (the tag), CaDiCaL 818c956, CadiBack 445ddc2, flags -msse4.2 -mpopcnt -mpclmul -DNDEBUG -DUSE_CADIBACK. Latest release (2026-10-09)
cms-5.17.0.model: `v` lines of signed literals ending in 0
cms-5.17.0.notes: Single thread is the default (--threads 1). `--verb 1` is the default verbosity, given explicitly. In 5.17.0 `-r` is `--seed`; in 5.13.0 it is `--random`.

cms-5.13.0.name: CryptoMiniSat
cms-5.13.0.obtained: prebuilt: upstream release asset, statically linked. Its `--version` reports CMS SHA1 7a62ccb, which is the tag plus 7 commits touching only CI, CMake files and html (no source change); flags -msse4.2 -mpopcnt -march=sandybridge -DNDEBUG -DYALSAT_FPU
cms-5.13.0.model: `v` lines of signed literals ending in 0
cms-5.13.0.notes: The version Xorcle v0.1's benchmarks used (v0.1 ran it as `cryptominisat5 <input>`). Single thread by default.

xorricane-0.4.2.11.name: Xorricane
xorricane-0.4.2.11.version: 0.4.2.11 at 9fb3be9 (the commit j-danner/Xorricane-paper pins as its submodule)
xorricane-0.4.2.11.tag: none: Xorricane has no GitHub release. Tag v0.4.2.11 (c9870066) is 3 commits older; those commits change only a copy-assignment signature (compiler warning), a CMake policy line and the README, so the two are the same solver

dependencies.name: m4ri
dependencies.url: https://github.com/malb/m4ri.git (cloned by Xorricane's own CMake at GIT_TAG bb78acf; setup_solvers.sh checks the full hash after the build)

xorricane-0.4.2.11.obtained: built: `cmake . && make xorricane` as upstream's README says (Release): g++ 14.3.1 -W -Wall -Wextra -Wswitch -Wsign-compare -ffast-math -pthread -march=native -mtune=native -O3 -DNDEBUG. jemalloc is optional upstream and absent here (its Dockerfile builds with it)
xorricane-0.4.2.11.model: `v` lines of signed literals ending in 0
xorricane-0.4.2.11.notes: Defaults (`--impl-lits 0`, `-delh avg_util`), as Soos's runs used it. Mate Soos's nine patches (xnf-tests/bugs-xorricane) all target code present in this version unchanged; none is applied.

2xornado-1.0.2.name: 2-Xornado

dependencies.name: libm4ri-0.0.20140914.so, built from m4ri release-20140914 (1c460b0): autoreconf --install && ./configure --disable-png && make

2xornado-1.0.2.obtained: prebuilt: upstream release asset ('Release used for benchmarking in paper SAT Solving Using XOR-OR-AND Normal Forms'), built by upstream with GNU 13.2.0 -O3 -march=native -fopenmp -DNDEBUG. It links two shared libraries the build machine lacked, supplied in solvers/lib/2xornado-1.0.2/; solvers/bin/2xornado-1.0.2 is a sh wrapper that sets LD_LIBRARY_PATH and execs solvers/libexec/2xornado-1.0.2
2xornado-1.0.2.model: one `v` line of signed literals ending in 0
2xornado-1.0.2.notes: Defaults (`-dh mp`, `-fls no`, `-pp fls_scc`), as Xorcle v0.1 ran it. v1.0.2 is the latest release; tag v1.0.3 (c6e6f8d) has no release or binary. The binary is linked with OpenMP and TBB; unpinned, it runs one thread (99% of one CPU).

xorcle-0.2.name: Xorcle
xorcle-0.2.obtained: built by `setup_solvers.sh xorcle`: `cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build` at the repository root, then build/xorcle installed as solvers/bin/xorcle-0.2

xorcle-0.1.name: Xorcle
xorcle-0.1.obtained: built by `setup_solvers.sh xorcle`: the tree of tag v0.1 built with its Makefile (`make CXX="c++ -include cstring"`, Release; v0.1 uses std::memcpy without including <cstring>), then bin/xorcle installed as solvers/bin/xorcle-0.1
